A charismatic, free-spirited rebel is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, where he immediately clashes with the rigid, authoritarian head nurse. Refusing to let the oppressive institutional rules break the human spirit, he rallies his fellow patients through clandestine acts of defiance and joy. As their covert resistance builds, the charismatic leader orchestrates a daring bid for true liberation, ultimately inspiring an unforgettable legacy of hope and rebellion.
